meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: Claude 能生成使用 Astropy 库的 Python 代码，处理天文数据：单位转换、坐标变换、FITS 文件读写、宇宙学计算、表格操作、时间处理等。
howto.when: 当你提出天文数据分析问题，需要编写或调试使用 Astropy 的 Python 代码时触发，例如坐标转换、FITS 文件操作或宇宙学计算。

say.text: 帮我用 Astropy 把 ICRS 坐标转为银道坐标。
say.note: Claude 会给出代码并运行结果。

say.text: 读取一个 FITS 文件，计算图像的中值。
say.note: Claude 会用 fits.getdata 并计算。

say.text: 用 Planck18 模型计算 z=1.5 的光度距离。
say.note: Claude 调用 cosmology 模块。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate Python code using the Astropy library for astronomical data analysis: unit conversions, coordinate transformations, FITS I/O, cosmology calculations, table operations, time handling, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions about astronomical data analysis that require coding with Astropy, e.g., coordinate transformations, FITS file operations, or cosmology calculations.

say_en.text: Convert ICRS coordinates to Galactic using Astropy.
Read a FITS file and compute the median of the image.
Calculate luminosity distance at z=1.5 with Planck18.
